page_title: MON 3-1 HAV | Monaco v Le Havre 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' What a wasted opportunity by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Arthur Desmas makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
90+6' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Le Havre.
90+4' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Le Havre are going to take it.
90+3' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
88' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' Substitution. Eliot Matazo (Monaco) on for George Ilenikhena.
86' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
86' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
82' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
79' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Yoann Salmier and he is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
79' The referee signals a substitution. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Yassine Kechta.
79' Substitution. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jordan Teze walks off.
78' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is adjudged offside.
78' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
78' 8:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) was too aggressive in his challenge.
73' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Oussama Targhalline is replaced by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
73' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) replacing Josue Casimir.
72' The game has come to an end for Daler Kuzyaev. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
72' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Stephanie Frappart signals that there was no infringement and the goal stands! The Monaco players celebrate.
72' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Monaco players aren’t happy.

70' 3 - 1 Goal! George Ilenikhena produces a great pass that finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the right side of the goal. 3:1.
68' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

66' 2 - 1 Stunning strike! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) latches on to a precise through ball from Wilfried Singo before unleashing an unstoppable shot inside the right post from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 2:1.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' The ball is cleared after Christopher Operi (Le Havre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
63' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
62' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
61' Substitution. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
60' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
58' The game is interrupted. Jordan Teze (Monaco) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
57' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

56' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Le Havre.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Monaco is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
55' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.

54' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Philipp Kohn blocks the shot with his legs.
53' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
52' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Goal! Yassine Kechta plays a pass to the feet of Josue Casimir (Le Havre), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 1:2.
49' Good chance! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
48' After what seems an eternity, referee Stephanie Frappart decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Le Havre, play to continue.
48' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Le Havre players aren’t happy.
46' Rough tackle by Folarin Balogun (Monaco). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Adi Hutter has made a change at the break. Denis Zakaria has come on in place of Lamine Camara (Monaco).
46' Half-time substitution. Soungoutou Magassa is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top right corner. Arthur Desmas displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement.
40' The resulting corner from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is cleared by the defence.
40' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Now Monaco have a corner.
37' It looks like Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
36' Monaco are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
35' The linesman raises his flag for offside before George Ilenikhena (Monaco) heads on.
34' Caio Henrique (Monaco) picks up an injury.
34' Stephanie Frappart couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Loic Nego (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
32' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' 1 - 1 Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
27' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
26' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle. George Ilenikhena (Monaco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
24' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
21' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
20' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
20' Monaco are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
17' Lamine Camara (Monaco) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
17' Lamine Camara (Monaco) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
16' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
13' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Takumi Minamino displays great vision and sends a pass to Jordan Teze (Monaco), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
8' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lamine Camara (Monaco).
7' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Monaco.
6' Loic Nego (Le Havre) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
6' Looks like Loic Nego (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
5' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' Monaco keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Le Havre will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is the one to supervise the game today.
